data_check_issues_handled_at_check.name: data_check_issues_handled_at_check
data_check_issues_handled_at_check.value:
("data_check_issues"."status" = 'open' and "data_check_issues"."handled_at" is null)
        or ("data_check_issues"."status" = 'handled' and "data_check_issues"."handled_at" is not null)

data_check_state_counts_check.name: data_check_state_counts_check
data_check_state_counts_check.value:
"data_check_state"."orphan_event_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."orphan_relation_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."orphan_case_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."error_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."warning_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."open_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."handled_count" >= 0

data_check_state_semantic_snapshot_check.name: data_check_state_semantic_snapshot_check
data_check_state_semantic_snapshot_check.value:
(
          "data_check_state"."last_snapshot_id" is null
          and "data_check_state"."semantic_status" is null
          and "data_check_state"."semantic_reason" is null
        ) or (
          "data_check_state"."last_snapshot_id" is not null
          and "data_check_state"."semantic_status" is not null
          and (
            ("data_check_state"."semantic_status" = 'completed' and "data_check_state"."semantic_reason" is null)
            or (
              "data_check_state"."semantic_status" = 'truncated'
              and "data_check_state"."semantic_reason" = 'candidate_limit'
            )
            or (
              "data_check_state"."semantic_status" = 'failed'
              and "data_check_state"."semantic_reason" = 'internal_failure'
            )
            or (
              "data_check_state"."semantic_status" = 'skipped'
              and "data_check_state"."semantic_reason" in (
                'not_recorded',
                'no_active_model',
                'worker_unreachable',
                'index_not_ready',
                'no_embeddings'
              )
            )
          )
        )

export_requests_scope_check.name: export_requests_scope_check
export_requests_scope_check.value:
(
          "export_requests"."export_type" = 'full'
          and cardinality("export_requests"."start_event_ids") = 0
          and "export_requests"."direction" is null
          and "export_requests"."depth" is null
        ) or (
          "export_requests"."export_type" = 'filtered'
          and cardinality("export_requests"."start_event_ids") between 1 and 100
          and "export_requests"."direction" is not null
          and "export_requests"."depth" between 1 and 10
        )

import_batches_counts_check.name: import_batches_counts_check
import_batches_counts_check.value:
"import_batches"."event_created" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."event_reused" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."case_created" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."case_reused" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."relation_created" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."relation_reused" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."relation_case_created" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."relation_case_reused" >= 0

import_records_related_record_check.name: import_records_related_record_check
import_records_related_record_check.value:
("import_records"."record_type" = 'relation_case' and "import_records"."related_record_id" is not null)
        or ("import_records"."record_type" <> 'relation_case' and "import_records"."related_record_id" is null)

semantic_embeddings_dimension_check.name: semantic_embeddings_dimension_check
semantic_embeddings_dimension_check.value:
("semantic_embeddings"."model_code" = 'bge-small-zh-v1.5' and vector_dims("semantic_embeddings"."embedding") = 512)
        or ("semantic_embeddings"."model_code" in ('multilingual-e5-small', 'granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2')
          and vector_dims("semantic_embeddings"."embedding") = 384)
        or ("semantic_embeddings"."model_code" = 'bge-m3' and vector_dims("semantic_embeddings"."embedding") = 1024)

semantic_index_state_active_model_check.name: semantic_index_state_active_model_check
semantic_index_state_active_model_check.value:
("semantic_index_state"."active_model_code" is null and "semantic_index_state"."status" = 'empty')
        or "semantic_index_state"."active_model_code" is not null

semantic_index_state_failure_metadata_ch.name: semantic_index_state_failure_metadata_check
semantic_index_state_failure_metadata_ch.value:
("semantic_index_state"."failure_stage" is null
          and "semantic_index_state"."failure_kind" is null
          and "semantic_index_state"."failure_code" is null)
        or ("semantic_index_state"."failure_stage" is not null
          and "semantic_index_state"."failure_kind" is not null
          and "semantic_index_state"."failure_code" is not null)

semantic_jobs_entity_target_check.name: semantic_jobs_entity_target_check
semantic_jobs_entity_target_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."job_type" = 'incremental'
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_type" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_id" is not null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."job_type" in ('download', 'load', 'full_index')
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_type" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_id" is null)

semantic_jobs_progress_check.name: semantic_jobs_progress_check
semantic_jobs_progress_check.value:
"semantic_jobs"."state_version" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."processed_items" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."total_items" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."processed_items" <= "semantic_jobs"."total_items"
        and "semantic_jobs"."downloaded_bytes" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."total_bytes" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."downloaded_bytes" <= "semantic_jobs"."total_bytes"
        and "semantic_jobs"."attempts" >= 0

semantic_jobs_lease_check.name: semantic_jobs_lease_check
semantic_jobs_lease_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" <> 'running'
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_owner" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null)

semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check.name: semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check
semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'queued'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."next_attempt_at" is null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."next_attempt_at" is null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'retry_wait'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."next_attempt_at" is not null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'failed'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."next_attempt_at" is null)

semantic_jobs_failure_metadata_check.name: semantic_jobs_failure_metadata_check
semantic_jobs_failure_metadata_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."failure_kind" is null and "semantic_jobs"."failure_code" is null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."failure_kind" is not null and "semantic_jobs"."failure_code" is not null)

semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_ch.name: semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_check
semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_ch.value:
("semantic_model_settings"."file_status" = 'downloaded' and "semantic_model_settings"."downloaded_at" is not null)
        or ("semantic_model_settings"."file_status" <> 'downloaded' and "semantic_model_settings"."downloaded_at" is null)

semantic_model_settings_failure_metadata.name: semantic_model_settings_failure_metadata_check
semantic_model_settings_failure_metadata.value:
("semantic_model_settings"."failure_kind" is null and "semantic_model_settings"."failure_code" is null)
        or ("semantic_model_settings"."failure_kind" is not null and "semantic_model_settings"."failure_code" is not null)
